conditions: The when expression is otherwise valid and its bound expression has type kotlin.Boolean.
limitations: Nullable Boolean, subjectless conditions, sealed hierarchies and special equality behavior follow separate rules.

triggers: Recheck any publisher correction, source integrity change, or contrary evidence about the pinned RFC edition.

statement: The Kotlin/Core 1.9 RFC treats a subject-bound when expression of non-null Boolean type as exhaustive when its conditions include constants for both true and false, even without else.
